title: Phenomenon Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: ‘Phenomenon' is an inviting and relaxing 3 bedroom/2.5 bath beach cottage in the heart of Seaside which is located steps away from the eastern pool, adult pool, croquet lawn and tennis courts.
description_expanded: **SNOWBIRD PROMOTION- Save 50% PER NIGHT January and February for monthly stays!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 2 Private Parking Spots plus 2 Additional Seaside Parking Passes - Short walk to the private Seaside beach with access via Savannah or Tupelo pavilions - 2 King bedrooms and a Bunk Room - TVs in all bedrooms with cable - Great Room TV cable + streaming available - You will have a total of 8 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - Walking/biking distance to Seaside, shops and restaurants - Fully stocked kitchen complete with a standard drip coffee maker - Two beach cruiser bikes included - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) ‘Phenomenon' is a relaxing, updated 3 bedroom/2.5 bath beach cottage located on the historic east side of Seaside just steps away from the adult pool, covered pool, croquet lawn and tennis courts. Private beach access is available at the Tupelo Pavilion and a short stroll brings you to Seaside’s famous restaurants, chapel, stores and all of activities that 30A has to offer. This cozy (hypo allergenic) cottage is decorated in classic and breezy colors. The downstairs open floor plan offers a living room with a flat screen TV, Apple TV and Wi-Fi, a modern well-equipped kitchen, dining for eight and a powder bath. Upstairs is the master bedroom (king) with a private bathroom (pair of vanities, shower and bathtub), a guest bedroom (king) and a bunk room (four twin beds) share a hall bathroom (pair of vanities and shower). Each bedroom has a TV and the tower room offers sunset views. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (sleeps 8) Bedroom 1: King master / private bathroom (separate tub and shower) and dual sinks. TV Bedroom 2: King. TV Shared Hall Bath (shower only) and dual sinks. Bedroom 3: Double bunk beds (sleeps 4) TV * Parking for 2 cars / private driveway ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Please note minimum age for renters is 25, no pets, large parties or more than 8 guests or guests under the age of 6. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. MISCELLANEOUS * Washer / Dryer * Kitchen Aid Mixer * Hair dryer * BBQ Grill * Beach toys * Minimum Age Limit For Renters * * No Pets Allowed * Smoking Not Allowed * Please no children under the age of 6* *Two bikes included with this rental FREE WiFi

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
